name: @mymehq/integration-sync-agent
description: Local-runtime connector for the existing sync agent. Defines the manifest the agent installs against; the actual execution is the daemon in the mymehq/sync-agent repo. The companion server-side migration at packages/server/src/scripts/migrate-sync-json-to-connection.ts re-presents an existing ~/.myme/sync.json as a Connection + Credential pair.
